tiers.name: Starter
tiers.who_its_for: small teams of 2-5 agents handling under 5k tickets/month
includes: AI reply drafts trained on your resolved tickets
tiers.rationale: Matches Help Scout's entry tier while offering AI differentiation; below Front and Zendesk to position as lean alternative

recommendation.positioning_note: Price at $29/seat to undercut Zendesk and Intercom by 40-60% while matching Help Scout's value; emphasize AI trained on real team voice as key differentiator.
risks: May be perceived as too expensive vs Help Scout Standard at $20
Lack of phone/live-chat could limit upsell

confidence.notes: 3+ established competitors confirmed via multiple independent sources and pricing pages scraped; Help Scout, Zendesk, Intercom, and Front all listed on G2/Capterra.
